purpose: Demonstrate revision history, same-source syndication, distinct-event guards, and unresolved verification

versions.headline: Temporary riverbank closures
versions.text: The council reports twelve access points closed following an inspection.

versions.headline: Correction: temporary riverbank closures
versions.text: Correction to the morning notice: nine access points were closed; the previous figure of twelve was incorrect.

articles.summary: Twelve riverbank access points reportedly closed.
The regional wire repeats the council's figure of twelve closures.

claims.statement: Twelve riverbank access points were closed.
Nine riverbank access points were closed.

analyst_notes: The first two reports are not independent corroboration: they share the council's v1 notice.
Preserve v1 rather than silently replacing its original quoted figure.
Surface the v2 correction and mark the earlier figure superseded.
The revised figure has a traceable source location but still needs human review.
Do not merge the independent footbridge inspection solely because of shared location and date.
